title: Completion with no free coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction on $n$ coordinates with no free coordinates. For any two binary vectors $x$ and $y$ of length $n$, completing $\rho$ using $x$ gives the same sign vector as completing it using $y$.
hypotheses_covered: the set of free coordinates of $\rho$ is empty
$x$ and $y$ are binary vectors of length $n$
